title: Sending International Payments: SWIFT and SEPA Options
summary: Explains when to send international payments via SWIFT (for global counterparties/cross-border transfers) vs SEPA (for euro-denominated recipients within the SEPA zone). Covers outgoing fees ($15 SWIFT with 3 free per month; $5 SEPA) and steps to select, verify, submit, and retain a confirmation reference.
faqs: When should I use SWIFT instead of SEPA for an international payment?
When is SEPA available for euro-denominated recipients?
How much are outgoing SWIFT wire fees, and what are the 3 free outgoing SWIFT wires per month?
How much are outgoing SEPA wire fees?
What should I verify about recipient details and destination support before submitting?
What is the recommended process after submitting (e.g., confirmation reference for reconciliation)?
keywords: 3 free outgoing SWIFT wires per month
